Based on the provided information, the HepaProtect vaccine has an efficacy of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection specifically in healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. The text does not provide data regarding its efficacy or suitability for age groups outside of this range (under 18 or over 55) or for individuals with other health conditions, other than those with a history of severe allergies to yeast or any vaccine component, who should avoid the vaccine.
